Snyk is now FedRAMP Moderate authorized
Snyk for public sector

Snyk helps federal, state, and local government institutions secure their code and open source dependencies, create SBOMs, maintain compliance, and more.

Book a live demo
Mission-informed application security

Snyk stays on the cutting edge of application security so you can focus on what matters most.

Shift left with a developer-friendly platform

Snyk empowers developers to write secure code from the start, meaning fewer vulnerabilities and a faster, more efficient deployment process.

Secure your software supply chain

Protect against rising cybersecurity threats by enabling secure design and comprehensive dependency tracking.

Deliver high-quality, next-gen citizen services

From executive order compliance to an industry-leading vulnerability feed, Snyk keeps you informed in an ever-evolving industry.

Comprehensive security coverage

Snyk arms you with developer security tools to keep your entire application secure from the start.

Industry-leading security intelligence

Our researchers hand-curate the Snyk Vulnerability Database with up-to-date security data and enriched metadata so you can accurately identify and reduce risk across your rapidly modernizing tech stack.

Continuous monitoring to find vulns faster

Snyk continuously monitors both direct and transitive dependencies, running in your Git repos and scanning from the IDE to catch vulnerabilities 2.4x faster than other providers, allowing you to respond quickly to zero days.

Generate SBOMs

Enable software transparency across teams and external entities with an easily generated software bill of materials exported directly from the CLI or API, and check SBOMs you receive for known vulnerabilities.

Safely adopt AI

Snyk helps satisfy the White House AI safety recommendations instituted in October 2023, securing both human- and AI-generated code as it’s written.
